description: DynamicTrees JSON file to define a tree family

common_species.description: The default species for this family. It must also be defined in the species/ folder

common_leaves.description: The default leaves properties for this family. They must be defined in the leaves_properties/ folder

primitive_log.description: The block that the logs are made of. The tree should drop these as items when felled.

primitive_stripped_log.description: The stripped version of the primitive log. (CAN BE OPTIONAL if disabled by generate_stripped_branch)

type.description: Allows for custom behavior beyond these properties. The options are {nether_fungus}. More can be added by addons.

max_branch_radius.description: The maximum radius the block can be. 8 is a full block.

stick.description: The stick item that the tree drops when with the logs.

generate_surface_root.description: If set to true, surface root blocks will be generated.

generate_stripped_branch.description: Whether or not the tree can be stripped with an axe.

branch_is_ladder.description: If true thin branches can be climbed by the player.

max_signal_depth.description: The maximum number of blocks the tree signal will travel. This limits the size of the tree.

primary_thickness.description: The radius of the branches at the tips, next to the leaves.

secondary_thickness.description: The radius of the branches immediately after the ones at the tips.

conifer_variants.description: Set to true if any of its species has a conifer_topper GenFeature.

loot_volume_multiplier.description: Multiplies the volume used to calculate the amount of logs and sticks dropped.
